description: This file defines mock classes and methods for GSSAPI library used in unit testing, including a mock implementation of GSSAPI context and library functions, with focus on security context expectations and status display.

classes.name: GssContextMockImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of GSSAPI context for testing, holding context attributes.

classes.name: MockGSSAPILibrary
classes.description: Mock class for GSSAPI library functions used in unit tests, allowing expectation setting and response simulation.

classes.name: SecurityContextQuery
classes.description: Structure representing expected security context query parameters and responses for testing.

methods.name: GssContextMockImpl
methods.description: Constructors and destructor for mock GSSAPI context.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns values from another GssContextMockImpl instance.

methods.name: MockGSSAPILibrary
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, and expectation setup methods for the mock GSSAPI library.

methods.name: ExpectSecurityContext
methods.description: Sets expected parameters and responses for init_sec_context calls.

methods.name: import_name
methods.description: Mocks importing a name in GSSAPI.

methods.name: release_name
methods.description: Mocks releasing a name in GSSAPI.

methods.name: release_buffer
methods.description: Mocks releasing a buffer in GSSAPI.

methods.name: display_name
methods.description: Mocks displaying a name in GSSAPI.

methods.name: display_status
methods.description: Mocks displaying status messages in GSSAPI.

methods.name: init_sec_context
methods.description: Mocks initiating security context in GSSAPI.

methods.name: wrap_size_limit
methods.description: Mocks calculating wrap size limit in GSSAPI.

methods.name: delete_sec_context
methods.description: Mocks deleting security context in GSSAPI.

methods.name: inquire_context
methods.description: Mocks inquiring context attributes in GSSAPI.

methods.name: GetLibraryNameForTesting
methods.description: Returns the library name for testing purposes.
